meta.descripcion: Sports clubs looking for physiotherapy, transport, printing, team meals and other services in exchange for visibility. Free access for businesses.

texto: It's not all about money. Many clubs are looking for services —physiotherapy, transport, printing, team meals— in exchange for visibility. If your business can cover any of them, it's the easiest way to start a partnership.
